result.summary: The application interface is generally well-structured, but there are a few layout and visual inconsistencies.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant title is being cut off in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text truncation or container width to ensure the restaurant name is fully visible or wrap it to the next line.

issues.description: The bottom-most pizza card is cut off at the bottom of the screen, creating an incomplete visual experience.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or margin to the scrollable container so the last element is fully visible before reaching the navigation bar.
